name: wealthy
description: A sense that you have a valued asset that many others may not have.

variations.name: wealthy in a scarce resource
variations.description: A sense that you have more of a valued physical asset than many others. 'Scarce' means that since you have that item, no one else can.

variations.name: wealthy in a non-scarce resource
variations.description: A sense that you have more of a valued social or mental asset than many others. 'Non-scarce' means that you having some doesn't keep it from others.

variations.name: wealth pride
variations.description: If having the asset makes you feel good about yourself, you may feel pride.
examples: I love showing off my fossil collection.

variations.name: wealth anxiety
variations.description: If having the asset makes you feel nervous, you may feel anxiety about someone being jealous or trying to take it.
examples: He has a great fossil collection, but won't show it to anyone.

variations.name: good but not enough
variations.description: A sense that you have more of a valued asset than many others, but still want more. This could be perceived as greed if the asset is scarce and in demand.

variations.name: graceful wealth
variations.description: A sense that you have more of a valued asset than many others, and are grateful and generous with it.

commentaries.quote: People need all different kinds of stuff. We keep track of who has how much of each kind, and this bookkeeping causes all sorts of emotions: from admiration and inspiration to envy and anger.
We are all wealthy in something, and could become even more rich in friends, skill, or health.

conditions: A sense that you have more of a valued asset than many others.
